subject.title: fix(auth): count token-type profiles in provider health status rollup

question: Should `models.authStatus` report effective token/setup-token health for OAuth-configured providers when no effective OAuth profile exists?
rationale: The patch is narrow and well-proven, but it changes the status semantics that dashboards and operator alerts may consume as an OAuth-health signal.

options.title: Accept Token Fallback
options.body: Land the current OAuth-first, token-second rollup because it matches runtime usability after setup-token migration.

options.title: Keep OAuth-Only Health
options.body: Pause or redesign the PR if this gateway status must remain a strict OAuth-login health signal even for token-backed migrations.

recommendation.title: Accept Token Fallback
recommendation.body: Land the current OAuth-first, token-second rollup because it matches runtime usability after setup-token migration.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the live assignee and strongest recent owner for model-auth status and auth-health history.
